name: print-social-catering-posts-yellow-condensed-type-and-greyscale-food
title: Catering pack with towering yellow condensed type, greyscale canapés and a spinning text badge
whatItIs: Ten off-white posts with huge thin yellow condensed words ('CATERING', 'TASTE THE PASSION', 'SINCE 1990') running vertically and horizontally, greyscale cut-out canapés and skewers, a circular 'Super Tasty' text ring, repeated 'Since 1990' lines, wavy rules and yellow oval badges.
whatItMeans: Stylish and editorial; greyscale food plus one yellow feels like a fashion magazine for food.
techniques: Make food greyscale and type the only colour.
Set a word in tall condensed caps that fills the height.
Wrap a slogan around a circle as a badge.
Repeat small text lines as texture.

vocabulary.definition: Text set along a circle path.
